title: Expression of PPAR-gamma TF by newly synthesized thiazolidine-2,4-diones to manage glycemic control: Insights from in silico, in vitro and experimental pharmacology in wistar rats.
authors: Gharge, Shankar; Alegaon, Shankar G; Ranade, Shriram D; Kavalapure, Rohini S; Prashantha Kumar, B R; Mhaske, Pravin C
one_liner_zh: 该研究通过药效团筛选、分子对接和MD模拟评估新型噻唑烷二酮类化合物对PPAR-γ转录因子的调控，虽涉及TF-DNA相关蛋白但核心是药物设计而非TF-DNA互作机制建模，方法可迁移性有限。
abstract: In pursuit of novel antidiabetic agents to combat type II diabetes mellitus, our study focused on identifying pharmacophoric features responsible for PPAR-gamma expression, a key regulator of glucose homeostasis and lipid metabolism. This goal was achieved through pharmacophore model generation and screening of rationally designed library of thiazolidine-2,4-dione hybrids (7a-7f). The top hits were synthesized, characterized, and evaluated for their in vitro and in vivo antidiabetic activities. Among these, compounds 7b and 7c emerged as promising candidates, exhibiting significant in vitro inhibitory activity against human pancreatic alpha-amylase (HPA) and human liver alpha-glucosidase (HLAG) enzymes, along with enhanced glucose uptake in L6 myotube cell lines. Specifically, compound 7b showed 29.04 +/- 1.13 microM HPA inhibition, 34.21 +/- 1.16 microg/mL HLAG inhibition, and 77.12 +/- 1.02 % glucose uptake, while compound 7c displayed 28.35 +/- 1.01 microM HPA inhibition, 26.21 +/- 1.17 microM HLAG inhibition, and 78.54 +/- 0.54 % glucose uptake. Mechanistic studies revealed a dose-dependent increase in PPAR-gamma transcription factor expression, supported by molecular docking that showed favorable interactions with key residues TYR473, SER289, and HIE323. Molecular dynamics simulations confirmed the stability of these interactions, and MM/GBSA binding free energy calculations indicated potential for further optimization. In vivo studies in STZ-induced diabetic Wistar rats demonstrated significant improvements in glucose homeostasis, insulin sensitivity, and lipid metabolism, with a notable decrease in triglycerides and VLDL levels. Compound 7c also showed an improved pharmacokinetic profile with a half-life of 4.01 h and an elimination rate constant of 0.325, compared to compound 7b. Both compounds enhanced glycogen content and antioxidant biomarkers, with a high safety profile (LD(50) of 500 mg/kg). Overall, compound 7c stands out as a promising lead for further development, with compound 7b also showing strong potential, providing valuable insights for future antidiabetic drug development efforts.
abstract_zh: 为寻求新型抗糖尿病药物以对抗II型糖尿病，我们的研究聚焦于识别负责PPAR-gamma表达的药效团特征，PPAR-gamma是葡萄糖稳态和脂质代谢的关键调节因子。这一目标通过药效团模型生成和对合理设计的噻唑烷-2,4-二酮杂合体（7a-7f）库的筛选得以实现。筛选出的最优化合物被合成、表征，并评估了其体外和体内抗糖尿病活性。其中，化合物7b和7c成为有前景的候选物，表现出显著的人胰腺α-淀粉酶（HPA）和人肝脏α-葡萄糖苷酶（HLAG）体外抑制活性，同时增强了L6肌管细胞系的葡萄糖摄取。具体而言，化合物7b显示HPA抑制率为29.04 ± 1.13微摩尔，HLAG抑制率为34.21 ± 1.16微克/毫升，葡萄糖摄取率为77.12 ± 1.02%；而化合物7c显示HPA抑制率为28.35 ± 1.01微摩尔，HLAG抑制率为26.21 ± 1.17微摩尔，葡萄糖摄取率为78.54 ± 0.54%。机制研究表明，PPAR-gamma转录因子表达呈剂量依赖性增加，分子对接支持其与关键残基TYR473、SER289和HIE323的有利相互作用。分子动力学模拟确认了这些相互作用的稳定性，MM/GBSA结合自由能计算表明其具有进一步优化的潜力。在STZ诱导的糖尿病Wistar大鼠体内研究中，观察到葡萄糖稳态、胰岛素敏感性和脂质代谢的显著改善，甘油三酯和VLDL水平显著降低。化合物7c还显示出改善的药代动力学特征，半衰期为4.01小时，消除速率常数为0.325，优于化合物7b。两种化合物均增强了糖原含量和抗氧化生物标志物，并具有高安全性（LD(50)为500毫克/千克）。总体而言，化合物7c作为进一步开发的有前景的先导化合物脱颖而出，化合物7b也显示出强大潜力，为未来抗糖尿病药物开发工作提供了宝贵见解。
